name: Default Speaker Model
description: Default output settings for character speakers

name: ReSpeaker XVF3800 USB Speaker
description: Playback side of the ReSpeaker XVF3800. Sharing one device between output and capture is what lets the XVF3800 cancel its own voice out of the mic feed, so a character can listen while it speaks.

name: C-Media USB Audio Adapter (playback)
description: Playback side of the common C-Media USB audio adapter, sold under many brand names. Drives a powered speaker from a USB port when the board's own headphone jack is unused or unavailable.

meta.echoCancellation: none (host-side only - this adapter has no DSP)
meta.notes: USB signature read from a live device on a MonsterNet node via /sys/bus/usb/devices. It identifies the MODEL, not the individual unit, so an identical replacement adapter still matches.
